name: @papercupai/linear-sync
description: Bidirectional background sync between harness features/issues and a Linear team. No dashboard CTAs — runs on a 30s cron, reacts to Linear webhooks, and pushes harness state changes via lifecycle hooks. Harness wins on field conflicts; remote-only metadata (assignee, priority) is mirrored read-only into a JSONB sidecar.
author: Papercusp

actions.name: backfill-local-to-remote
actions.label: Push every harness feature/issue to Linear

actions.name: backfill-remote-to-local
actions.label: Import every Linear issue tagged for this harness

defaultTeamKey.description: Linear team key (e.g. ENG). One of teamKey/teamId required.

defaultTeamId.description: Linear team UUID. Overrides teamKey if both set.

labelPrefix.description: Label prefix; the plugin owns labels matching `<prefix>-*`

hiddenReason: Not ready yet — outbound integration is functional against a mock; live wiring against real Jira/Linear/Notion/Slack tenants is not yet verified. Hidden from marketplace until v1.0.
